from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u009/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b5cf2eca.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rmid = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    cmid = next(j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == 3 for i in range(h)))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 3: continue
            rr = r if r < rmid else r-rmid-1
            cc = c if c < cmid else c-cmid-1
            if ((rr+1) & (cc+1)) != 0: out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
p.write_text(s)

for i in range(12):g[i][6]=3
g[8]=[3]*12
